purpose: Document local registry evidence and bounded public parcel-geometry route review.
assessment: Inspected the official interactive viewer and its publicly linked loader/search scripts. The integration endpoint accepts parcel inscription or sector/quadra and its response includes address-related fields without a documented field-selection parameter. No property key, address or broad geometry request was submitted.
registryAssessment: The city’s public service says users can search urban municipal tax registration from a map, and IPLAM describes the municipal technical cadastre. IPLAM states editable cadastral cartography (including Shapefile/DWG) is restricted to institutional partner agencies.

officialPrimarySources.observation: City service documentation advertises map-based urban registration lookup; IPLAM maintains the technical cadastre. Official disclosure rules restrict editable cadastral map files to institutional partner agencies.
